title: The Helpful Pup
lines: Our pup Bud is small and harmless.
Jill had one sock on and one off.
The other sock was lost. Jill felt sad.
She looked in the box by her bed.
It was full of rags. That was useless.
She looked under the bed. Just dust.
Then Jill had a plan. Bud can smell!
She held the one sock up to his nose.
Bud is helpful when a sock gets lost.
He went to the rug and had a smell.
Then he dug up the lost sock for her.
It was under the rug all the time.
Jill was thankful and gave Bud a pat.
Now Jill has both socks on her feet.

questions.ask: Jill looked in two spots first. What did she find?
questions.listenFor: A box full of rags, and dust under the bed. Both were useless.

questions.ask: What was Jill's plan with the sock she still had?
questions.listenFor: She held it up to Bud's nose so he could smell it and find the other one.

questions.ask: When has someone been helpful to you? Tell me about it.
questions.listenFor: Any story is fine. Listen for them to use the word helpful.
